paite: Unaute aw, mi takhial bangpeuh a hihlai phawkin naom leh, nou kha mite aw, Khemna ka tuak sam kha ding e, chia kiveng hoih kawmin, huchibang mi tuh nunnemna lungsim toh dingsak thak nawn un.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

paite: Na puakgikte uh kidawn chiat un, huchiin Kris dan thu na jui uh ahi ding.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

paite: Mi bangmah hi lou piin, mi lian kuama a kibawl leh, a kikhem tawm lel ahi ngala.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

paite: Mi chihin amah thilhih tuh enchian chiat jaw hen; huchia midang toh kiteha-ki-uangsak lou-a amahmaha suanhuai thil ahih theihna dingin.
english: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.

paite: Mi chihin amah puak po ding ahi ngala.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

paite: Huan, thuhilha omin thil hoih tengteng a hilhpa kiangah pe sam hen.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

paite: Khemin om kei un; Pathian jaw zekhema mawkbawl vual ahi kei; min a tuh peuh uh huaimah a at nawn ngei ding a hih jiakin.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

paite: Amah salama tuhin saa om siatna a at ding. Khalama tuhin bel khaa kipan khantawn hinna a at ding.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

paite: Huchiin, thil hoih hih chimtak kei ni; i lungkiak keileh a hun takah i at ngei ding ahi ngala.
english: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

paite: Huchiin, lemtang hun i neihdan bang jelin mi tengteng tungah thil hoih hih ni, ginna inkuanpihte laka omte tungah hi khol diak hen.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

paite: Keimah khut mahmaha na kiang ua lai gol pipia ka hichi gelh en un.
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

paite: Saa mel kilawmsak utte peuhmahin zeksuma om dingin nou a honsawl teitei nak ua; bangmah dang jiak leng ahi keia, Kris kros jiaka sawi a thuak louhna ding lel uh ahi.
english: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

paite: Zeksumte nangawnin leng dan thu a jui tuan sam kei ua, na sa uah, suan ding a neih theihna dingun na zek uh kisum leh chih a ut lel uh ahi.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

paite: Ken jaw i Toupa Jesu Kris kros loungal ka suan louh dingdan, huai kros jiakin khovel kei adingin kilhdenin ka om hi.
english: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

paite: Siamthak nawnna lou jaw, zeksum chih bangmah ahi keia, zeksumlouh leng bangmah ahi sam kei hi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

paite: Huan, huai dan banga om peuhmahte tungah lemna leh hehpihna om hen, Pathian Isrealte tung ngei ah.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

paite: Tubansiah kuamahin honhihbuai nawn kei hen; ka pumpi ah Jesu chiamtehnate ka pu ngala.Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na kha kiang uah om hen. Amen.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

paite: Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Kris hehpihna na kha kiang uah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
